end.summary:
Aarav practised ordering BCE and CE dates on a timeline.
They correctly ordered BCE years with larger numbers farther left and earlier.
They correctly placed 1 CE after 1 BCE and ordered 3000 BCE, 500 BCE, 100 CE, 1947 CE.
They practised identifying 1947 CE as part of the 20th century.
They asked several times for a drawn number line; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Aarav practised reading BCE and CE dates on a timeline, including the direction of BCE years and placing 1 CE after 1 BCE. They also worked through the 20th-century placement of 1947 CE; the first-century mix-up was corrected later in the lesson. At home, draw a number line and place 3000 BCE, 500 BCE, 1 BCE, 1 CE, 100 CE, and 1947 CE together.
